commit.message: feat(helm): wire truthful local model preview

interface_mismatches: The current terminal policy can label Codex selectable and ready even though the Slice-1 primary-chat membrane must reject its shell-capable adapter.
The current bridge has no Ollama terminal adapter even when an exact local model is installed and the loopback runtime-provider completion path is healthy.
Provider/key liveness is currently presented more strongly than exact executable chat-route proof.
honest_blockers: The local Mistral preview route is not one of the seven locked Helm seats and must never increment or promote the Helm OnCall projection.
Claude headless completion is blocked by a low-credit account and the configured OpenRouter route is invalid or un-funded; this packet does not claim to repair those external provider accounts.
The preview proves one loopback no-tools chat journey on this machine, not remote deployment or seven-of-seven live provider proof.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the packet-scoped commit or unset DHARMA_HELM_LOCAL_PREVIEW_MODEL. No migration or durable route-truth state is introduced.
